meta.name: pdf-converter
meta.description: PDF converter powered by MinerU — convert PDF to Word, Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, or plain text. Also handles image-to-text OCR, scanned document recognition, and Office formats (DOCX, PPTX, Excel). Supports 80+ languages. Use this skill when the user wants to convert, extract, read, parse, or summarize any PDF or document. Also applies when the user shares a PDF file or link and asks about its content, needs tables or formulas extracted, wants PDF OCR, or says things like 'turn this into a doc' or 'what does this paper say'.
